dataset: PyThaiNLP Thai word list, filtered for pure Thai-script lexical entries
transformation: Preserve source order; retain only non-empty lines consisting exclusively of Unicode Thai-block code points U+0E00–U+0E7F; deduplicate exact strings; no Wisesight samples used to build this dictionary.
intended_use: Dictionary for deterministic maximum-matching word segmentation; not a pronunciation dictionary and not a word-boundary gold set.
caveat: The source list contains lexical phrases as well as words, so greedy longest matching may over-merge compounds. Metrics on Wisesight are source-annotated diagnostics, not independent expert accuracy.
